evidence.quote: Solved it..i shouldn't use quote.identifiers configuration" after Chris Cranford: "Oracle records all object names in upper-case ... primary.key.fields ... cannot be located

notes: 'no key fields defined' came from identifier case mismatch caused by quote.identifiers=true with Oracle upper-case names; settled by JdbcChangeEventSink key-field resolution.
